tasks.title: CLP/JPY/KWD amounts rendered with the wrong number of decimals
Multiple partial refunds can exceed the captured amount
tasks.summary: Fixed PAY-4420 by checking refund amounts against the payment's remaining amount (p.Remaining().Minor) rather than total payment amount (p.Amount.Minor) in payment.Service.Refund, and handling StatusRefunded such that any subsequent refunds exceed the remaining amount (0) and are rejected with ErrRefundExceedsRemaining (HTTP 422 refund_exceeds_remaining) without modifying the payment. Added unit and API tests verifying that multiple refunds cannot exceed the payment amount, refunds exceeding remaining are rejected with 422, exact remaining moves payment to REFUNDED, and refunds on REFUNDED payments are rejected with 422.

tasks.title: Cursor pagination silently drops one payment per page
tasks.summary: Fixed payment pagination offset handling in store.Memory.ListByMerchant by removing the erroneous offset increment after decoding the cursor. Since encodeCursor already encodes the ending offset (the index of the first item on the next page), incrementing it caused the service to skip one payment on every page transition. Added comprehensive pagination tests covering multiple page sizes, total counts (including exact multiples of the limit), and full API reconciliation walks.

tasks.title: Webhook dispatcher retries permanent 4xx failures and gives up on 5xx
tasks.summary:
Fixed webhook retry logic in `webhook/dispatcher.go`:
- Updated `retryable()` to check `status >= 500 && status < 600` instead of `status >= 400 && status < 500`, correctly retrying transport errors, 408, 429, and 5xx per the documented retry policy in README.md.
- Ensured permanent 4xx failures (such as 400, 401, 404, 410) fail on the first attempt without retries and are sent straight to the dead-letter list recording 1 attempt and the HTTP status.
- Ensured dead letters correctly record the number of attempts executed and the last HTTP status.
- Added comprehensive unit tests in `webhook/webhook_test.go` and `api/api_test.go` verifying 4xx permanent failures, 5xx retries and backoff, 408/429 retries, and dead-letter records.

tasks.title: Idempotency keys never expire after 24h
tasks.summary:
Fixed idempotency key TTL expiration and memory eviction:
- Corrected the purge condition in idempotency.Memory.purgeLocked from `now.Sub(r.ExpiresAt) > m.ttl` (which kept records for 2*TTL / 48 hours) to `!now.Before(r.ExpiresAt)` so records are evicted once `now >= ExpiresAt` (24h TTL).
- Updated `Begin`, `Complete`, and `Release` to evict and treat expired records as never used when accessed (`now >= ExpiresAt`), allowing Begin to start a fresh request regardless of fingerprint and Complete/Release to return ErrUnknownKey.
- Updated `Len` to purge expired records when the purge interval has elapsed.
- Added comprehensive unit tests in `idempotency` and an end-to-end API test covering key reuse after 24h.

tasks.title: Every client error is returned as 500 internal_error
Late webhook retries fire with no delay
tasks.summary: Fixed integer overflow in Policy.Backoff by preventing large bit shifts from wrapping int64 duration to negative values. The calculation now caps intermediate values safely at MaxDelay before doubling, clamps non-positive attempt counts to attempt 1, and guards against shift counts exceeding 62, ensuring retry intervals are always positive, monotonically non-decreasing, and capped at MaxDelay.

tasks.title: Add payment cancellation (CANCELED status + endpoint + webhook)
Filter the merchant payment listing by status
Accept and return integer minor units, backward compatible
tasks.summary: Added support for integer minor units (amount_minor) on POST /payments and POST /payments/{id}/refunds alongside legacy decimal amount strings. Validated that at least one is provided and that both must match if provided. Updated payment responses across all endpoints to include amount_minor, fee_minor, refunded_minor, remaining_minor, and amount_minor on refund items. Verified cross-format idempotency replay and rejection of unknown JSON fields.

tasks.title: Centralize the payment status machine in one transition table
tasks.summary:
Implemented PAY-4541:
- Added `CanTransition(from, to Status) bool` in `package payment` as the single source of truth for allowed status transitions (CREATED->PENDING, CREATED->DECLINED, PENDING->SUCCEEDED, PENDING->DECLINED, SUCCEEDED->REFUNDED).
- Updated `Status.Final()` to check transitions via `CanTransition`.
- Replaced the status switch blocks in `payment.Service` (`Authorize`, `Capture`, `Decline`, `Refund`) with `CanTransition` validation, preserving all existing behavior, error types, error messages, and events.
- Added comprehensive unit tests in `payment/service_test.go` verifying `CanTransition` across all status pairs and edge cases, along with `Status.Final()`.

tasks.title: Idempotency store is not safe under concurrent retries
tasks.summary:
Fixed concurrent map read/write crashes and race conditions in package idempotency:
- Held `m.mu` across the entire `Begin` method in `idempotency.Memory` so checking record existence/expiry and registering a new in-progress record is atomic, ensuring at most one concurrent Begin starts the request and retries receive ErrInProgress.
- Synchronized `Complete` under `m.mu.Lock()` to prevent concurrent map reads/writes and data races when mutating record completion status and response data.
- Synchronized the key check in `Release` under `m.mu.Lock()` before deleting the record.
- Added concurrency and expiry tests in `idempotency/store_test.go` and concurrent retry refund integration tests in `api/api_test.go`.

tasks.title: In-memory repository shares mutable state with callers
Idempotency Begin gets slower with every stored key
tasks.summary: Fixed idempotency.(*Memory).Begin scaling issue (PAY-4570) where purgeLocked allocated a slice of all stored keys and sorted it with sort.Slice on every Begin call, causing O(N log N) latency under traffic. Replaced the full-store sort with an intrusive doubly-linked list ordered by expiration time. Checking and evicting expired records from the head of the list is now O(1) in the common case (microseconds latency regardless of stored keys), while ensuring expired records are evicted and expired keys are never replayed.

tasks.title: Split payouts do not reconcile with the charged amount
tasks.summary: Fixed money.Allocate to use the largest remainder method with exact integer arithmetic (Hare-Niemeyer method) instead of independent floating-point rounding. Payout splits now always sum exactly to the original amount, every part differs from its exact proportional share by less than one minor unit, and leftover minor units are distributed one each to the parts with the largest remainder with ties broken by lower index.

tasks.title: Identical retries rejected as idempotency key reuse
tasks.summary: Fixed PAY-4593 where mobile SDK retries were rejected with 422 idempotency_key_reused due to JSON re-encoding (field reordering, whitespace, lowercase currency, amount decimal places). Replaced raw request body hashing with canonical semantic fingerprinting for payment creation (merchant ID and normalized amount) and refunds (payment ID and normalized refund amount). Added tests verifying idempotent replays on semantic retry variations for both payments and refunds.

tasks.title: Processing fees overcharged by one cent
tasks.summary: Fixed money.Fee to follow the finance half-to-even (banker's rounding) policy and avoid floating-point precision loss on large amounts. Computed the fee exactly using math/bits (Mul64 and Div64) on 128-bit integer products, correctly rounding half-way cases (remainder == 5000) to the nearest even integer, and added comprehensive tests for banker's rounding and large amounts.
